title: Sambhar Whole Wheat Bites
description: A crunchy and flavorful Indian-inspired snack made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the flour and sambhar powder.
Add the melted butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk.
Place the disks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with a little water and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown.
